```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("/Volumes/h30492/farkkilab2/4_CellCycle/geomx/Data/Nika_Masters_thesis_gsea_data_for_analysis/Sample_Selection_080226_adjusted.csv",sep = ";", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(df)
```


```{r}
df <- df %>% rename(
  `NACT status` = `NACT`, 
  `Discovery CyCIF` = `Discovery.CyCIF`,
  `HRP status`=`HRP.status`
)
```
```{r}
df$`Expansion CyCIF` <- "yes"
```




```{r}
df <- df[order(df$GeoMx, df$Xenium), ]
```

```{r}
col_expansion <- c("yes"= "#FD8F52")
col_discovery  <- c("yes"= "#FAC205")
col_geomx <- c("yes"="#069AF3")
col_xenium  <- c("yes"= "#C79FEF")
col_HR <- c("HRD"="#386641","HRP"="#FF4500","unreliable"= "white","not known"="white")
col_tissue <- c("Omentum"= "#56C596", "Adnexa"= "#329D9C","Ovary"="#205072")

col_NACT <- c("IDS"="#ff5858","PDS"="green")


colours <- list(
  "Expansion CyCIF"=col_expansion,
  "Discovery CyCIF"=col_discovery,
  "GeoMx" =col_geomx,
  "Xenium"=col_xenium,
  "Tissue" = col_tissue,
  "HRP status" = col_HR,
  "NACT status"=col_NACT
)
```


```{r}
Rowann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df =df[,c("Expansion CyCIF","Discovery CyCIF","GeoMx","Xenium","NACT status","Tissue", "HRP status")],         # use all columns
  which = "column",
  col = colours,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  gap = unit(c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 2, 0.8, 0.8), "mm"),
  na_col = "white"
)

```






```{r}

df$Sample_num <- 1:nrow(df)
mat <- t(as.matrix(df$Sample_num))
colnames(mat)<- df$Sample
 
 
hmap <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  top_annotation = Rowann,
  width = unit(10, "cm"),
  height = unit(5, "cm"),
  column_names_rot=90,
  column_names_side = "top",
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4, fontface = "bold", rot = 90, just = "left"),

  )

draw(hmap, show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,annotation_legend_side = "bottom", merge_legends = FALSE)


```



```{r}
# 1. Rename the column in your dataframe first
# This ensures the label on the right side of the plot updates automatically
#library(dplyr)
df <- df %>% rename(`t-CyCIF Samples` = `Expansion CyCIF`)

# Rename columns in df for a more formal legend
df <- df %>% rename(
  `t-CyCIF Data` = `t-CyCIF Samples`,
  `Treatment Status` = `NACT status`,
  `Anatomical Site` = `Tissue`
)

# Remember to update your 'colours' list keys to match these new names!
# Update your colours list to match the new name
colours[["t-CyCIF Data"]] <- col_expansion
colours[["Treatment Status"]] <- col_NACT
colours[["Anatomical Site"]] <- col_tissue

# 2. Update Annotation with the new column name
Rowann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = df[, c("t-CyCIF Data", "Treatment Status", "Anatomical Site")], 
  which = "column",
  col = colours,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), 
  gap = unit(c(1, 1), "mm"),            
  na_col = "white"
)

# 3. Create Heatmap
hmap <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  top_annotation = Rowann,
  width = unit(15, "cm"), 
  height = unit(0.01, "cm"),
  column_names_side = "bottom",
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 5, fontface = "bold"),
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  
  # Title and Justification
  column_title = "t-CyCIF Sample Cohort Overview",
  column_title_side = "top",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  #column_title_just = "left" # Moves the title to the left
)

# 4. Final Draw
draw(
  hmap, 
  annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
  merge_legends = FALSE
)
```
